# DUDUBAO

> Magnetic toys and magnetic play systems for brands, with OEM / private-label and project-based ODM support. Wholesale sourcing for distributors and retailers is also available.

## Company
DUDUBAO is a magnetic toy manufacturer with our factory in Yuyao, Ningbo, China. Our factory produces magnetic toys and related play systems, with OEM / private-label and project-based ODM services.

## Products and project scope
The range includes standard and MINI magnetic tiles, ball runs, bell play systems, construction vehicle sets, and selected accessories. MINI is a separate size branch; confirm compatibility for the chosen products.
OEM discussions cover branding, packaging, colors, set configuration and selected existing accessories. New shapes, structures and tooling require separate feasibility, testing, commercial and IP review.
Custom and private-label orders start at 500 sets per SKU. Special packaging or dedicated accessories may require a higher MOQ. Small DUDUBAO-branded stock orders depend on actual inventory.
In-stock samples typically take about 7 days; color or packaging samples about 15 days after requirements, artwork, payment and necessary approvals. Standard samples are normally charged, with international courier paid by the buyer. New development is reviewed separately.
Third-party test reports (EN71, AS/NZS) are available on request for the selected product and destination. Windmill-inspired square tile design records cover China and Europe; project IP scope is reviewed separately.
